SAFETY_G8_CONTROL.canonical_full_definition: R=1 implies NC/DAC/TTC/EP/Comfort1 for this scorer; DDC not multiplied into canonical and reported separately

negative_high_semantics.interpretation: Relative downweighting versus higher-EP/higher-canonical safe/Comfort1 alternatives is not the same as a canonical order inversion; rawA sign is not parameter gradient

SAFETY_G8_CONTROL.PG0_scope: Counts are local rank/scene groups; not entire global optimizer anchor-only steps

conclusions_zh: 完整2×1000组/2×8000候选，2000文件真实读取/hash、0异常，1000/1000同rank/collection场景。Endpoint全部1000组评分动作精确绑定endpoint_policy.action，全部不同于未评分的ODE mean。
Endpoint135 PG0=109真正canonical全1+26全安全EP1但Comfort不同，0全failtie；Control60 PG0=1全1+57Comfort不同+2allfailtie。Endpoint更多PG0主要是成功满分，而非失败无信号。
Saturated在Endpoint仅激活26/1000组（208候选，169高分新增正A），保留109满分PG0；control可激活57组。Endpoint正高分normalized信用质量只增加0.774%，control增加2.976%。这是冻结信用回放，非训练提升。
Endpoint447/4756高分为负（9.399%），control220/2670（8.240%）。Endpoint仅64/447有较低canonical正A见证，control171/220；其余Endpoint383个都有实际更高canonical/更高EP的strict4正A替代。负high数量不能直接叫信用错误。
真正可抵消的质量倒置Endpoint为25组/69对，control81组/340对；均为更高EP、Comfort1→0导致canonical下降，平均canonical差12.551/12.279分。Endpoint反序更少，但单对差距仍大。
Inversion可在Endpoint清除34个负high，减少4.270normalized负信用质量（8.069%）；其余413仍负。Protected可删除全部447负high、移除52.918质量，却也删除383个没有canonical反序的相对负信用并允许组均值偏正。二者不能当同一规则。
Endpoint原Safety world64 rawA std均值.313923，control.370154；两者global normalized RMS都约1，active-group RMS1.0752/1.0314，原cap5命中均0。Endpoint高分单位normalized负质量增加约21.50%，其raw单位质量反而略低；不可由此推断参数梯度更大。
现有完整NAV500 Endpoint−control为−.537565分（已有44log CI[−.844736,−.242701]）；TRAIN候选更优并未保证部署更优。Endpoint jointSUM24条件密度、replay与control clamped W3 mean proxy不同，信用尺度不能替代这些机制的归因。

recommended_combination_review.first: Keep the already assigned Endpoint LR*.2 single-factor study clean, and read complete native1000 deployment evidence. These actual credit results do not support urgently stacking credit tricks to repair a supposed failed-PG0 crisis.

saturated.target: Only26/1000 Endpoint groups;109 true-full groups intentionally unchanged
saturated.limitation: Small extra positive-high credit mass; no new failure-support repair; does not affect447 active high negatives

inversion.target: 25/1000 groups,64 involved negatives/69 clear canonical inversions; preserves raw group sum
inversion.limitation: Only8.07% Endpoint negative-high normalized mass removed, much less than control. Do not extrapolate to bulk high-retention problem

protected.limitation: 383 lack observed canonical inversion; unconditional absolute-quality protection suppresses legitimate relative EP/canonical discrimination and changes groupmean. Needs its own complete results and independent Endpoint credit-only contrast, not presumed beneficial

recommended_combination_review.implementation_guard: Any later Endpoint+credit module must change finalized advantages only while retaining EndpointLoss conditionalSUM24, original sourceW3 anchor, likelihood/noise/RNG/optimizer and recovery. Existing source-PPO actor loss mixins cannot simply be stacked.

limits: All first500 behavior payloads actually read+SHA256; every candidate label binds its actual submitted FP32 action. Endpoint chain[-1] is unscored ODE mean, never substituted for endpoint_policy.action.
Same scene order does not mean same theta/roots/innovations: policy and RNG consumption diverge during training. Full measured encountered distributions, not a frozen-theta sampler causal comparison.
Only frozen credit counterfactuals on already-scored actions; no new trajectory scores, policy logp, replay optimization or predicted NAV gains.
Endpoint uses conditional jointSUM24 logp and sourceW3mean anchor; Control uses clamped dimension-mean W3 transition proxy. Equal normalizedA is not equal parameter gradient or anchor strength.
More high-quality negativeA in absolute count cannot establish worse conflict. Rates per strict-high and weighted masses/gaps reported; A signs before cap/PPO are not parameter gradients.

Do not stack an old Saturated/Protected/SourceLoss actor mixin onto Endpoint loss: future credit-only composition must keep EndpointLoss/conditional likelihood/anchor and native pending validators, independently registered.

result.legacy_high_0p8_caveat: Original paired high_to_zero uses .8; fixed_0p9_cohorts explicitly uses .9.

credit_scale_comparison.interpretation: Endpoint raw std lower; normalization fixes global RMS near1, not loss/parameter gradient. Zero groups remain in scale; active conditional RMS differs. No candidate reaches cap5, which says nothing about later PPO ratio clipping.
